title: 693. Longest Continuous Increasing Subsequence

examples.explanation: The run [1,3,5] has length 3; the later run [4,7] has length 2.
No adjacent pair increases, so the best is a single element.
The whole array is strictly increasing.

hints: Only neighbors matter: extend the current run when nums[i] > nums[i-1], else restart at 1.
Keep the maximum run seen so far.
